text: in thy sight: Heb. before thine eyes
bloody and deceitful man: Heb. man of bloods and deceit
thy holy temple: Heb. the temple of thy holiness
mine enemies: Heb. those which observe me
faithfulness: Or, steadfastness | in their mouth: Heb. in his mouth i. in the mouth of any of them | very wickedness: Heb. wickedness
Destroy thou them: Or, make them guilty | by their own counsels: Or, from their counsels
defendest them: Heb. thou coverest over, or protectest them
